review:
BGaming built this one with Casinolytics, using data from thousands of hours of casino streams to tune how often things happen – and you can feel it. It's a 6x8 cluster grid: five or more connected symbols win, and every win switches on cell multipliers up to 10x.

After a win, Dig-up can throw in sticky wilds, a Booster, a Destroyer or a scatter, so the board changes mid-spin. Very high volatility, 10,000x max and a 97% RTP – one of the best we list. Free spins about once every 321 spins, so it can take a while.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
